findings.issue_summary: Foreground service declared and active for smart glasses camera, microphone, and media playback streaming.
findings.evidence: WearableStreamingService is declared with android:foregroundServiceType="camera|microphone|mediaPlayback" and implements startForeground() with notification.
findings.recommendation: Play Console Declaration Required: Ensure you complete the Foreground Service declaration form in Play Console (App content section) for camera, microphone, and mediaPlayback types prior to submission.

findings.issue_summary: CAMERA, RECORD_AUDIO, and BLUETOOTH_CONNECT runtime permissions requested.
findings.evidence: Manifest requests CAMERA, RECORD_AUDIO, and BLUETOOTH_CONNECT for Meta Wearables smart glasses video feed and voice AI generation.
findings.recommendation: Provide clear runtime rationale dialogs explaining why camera and audio access are required before requesting permissions.
